question: Should ClawSweeper standardize the proposed v1 cross-route fingerprint and seven-day durable receipt contract, preserving legacy-only admission while suppressing only matching opposite-route deliveries?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded and has credible local proof, but selecting the permanent identity inputs, retention period, and rollout order changes the repository's reliability and control-plane policy rather than resolving a purely mechanical defect.

options.title: Approve staged cross-route coalescing
options.body: Accept the v1 identity and seven-day receipt policy, require a rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674, and require the paired-route canary again before merge.

options.title: Pause the protocol change
options.body: Keep both routes independently admitted until maintainers choose a different canonical-ingress or coalescing contract.

recommendation.title: Approve staged cross-route coalescing
recommendation.body: Accept the v1 identity and seven-day receipt policy, require a rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674, and require the paired-route canary again before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The earlier direct-only proposal was closed under Peter's routing decision to retain the documented compatibility path, so this successor policy choice should return to that owner.
